title: Motion Sciences anti-gravity effort debunked
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Motion Sciences anti-gravity effort debunked, about 2010 at Provo Airport hangar, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, in 2010 Dr. Puthoff and Dr. Green were part of the science advisory board for an effort called Motion Sciences

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an effort called Motion Sciences, run around 2010 out of a hangar at the Provo Airport in Utah, that aimed to build anti-gravity technology, a way of lifting things without pushing against air or ground. He says two scientists, Dr. Hal Puthoff and Dr. Kit Green, sat on its science advisory board, alongside a businessman named Joe Firmage, and that he was there when the effort's claims were shown not to hold up.
